hero.title: Management Trainee · Baker Tilly ASA  |  ACCA Part-Qualified  |  Finance & Data
hero.summary: ACCA Part-Qualified professional (10/13 papers passed) with external audit experience at Baker Tilly ASA, contributing to financial statement audits for European clients across shipping, investment holding, and retail sectors. Skilled in financial data analysis, variance analysis, and management reporting, with hands-on experience building financial dashboards and reports in Power BI and Excel. Exposure to ledger-level data cleaning, structured financial documentation, and IFRS-based reporting. Keen to apply analytical and data visualisation skills in a Financial Planning & Analysis or Business Intelligence capacity.
hero.relocateText: 🌍 Open to relocation and remote work globally — UAE · Cyprus · UK · Singapore

experience.company: Baker Tilly ASA · Global Offshoring Services
bullets: Contributed to financial statement audits for 9 European clients across shipping (4 ship-owning companies), investment holding (4 companies), and retail & franchise (Hans & Gretel), performing substantive procedures under IFRS and ISA frameworks.

Performed analytical review procedures including fluctuation analysis across revenue, expenses, and balance sheet accounts, identifying variances and unusual trends for escalation to senior reviewers.
Carried out data cleaning and sanitisation of detailed client ledgers, organising and validating large volumes of transactional data to support audit evidence and financial analysis.
Prepared audit working papers covering planning documentation, risk assessment, substantive testing, and audit evidence in accordance with ISA methodology across eight engagements.
Performed revenue and expense testing including vouching, tracing, cut-off testing, and recalculation to verify completeness, occurrence, and accuracy of financial statement balances.

experience.context: Undertaken on a part-time basis alongside ACCA studies to build professional competencies in a real business environment.
bullets: Developed patient-facing communication and client interaction skills in a healthcare setting, managing appointments and handling sensitive client queries with professionalism.

Applied data representation tools — Excel dashboards and Power BI reports — to track revenue, expenses, and operational KPIs, providing management with monthly performance visibility. Proprietary data and dashboards cannot be shared externally.
Managed billing operations, daily revenue reconciliation, and supplier account management, gaining practical exposure to end-to-end financial workflow management.
Oversaw stock monitoring and procurement tracking using structured data workflows, ensuring adequate inventory levels and minimising operational disruption.

projects.name: Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard tracking revenue trends, product performance, and regional sales KPIs with dynamic filtering and drill-through capabilities.
projects.details: This interactive dashboard allows management to drill down into regional sales figures, spot underperforming products, and optimise inventory distribution. The DAX models ensure quick load times despite processing large volumes of transactional data. Built for a private company — client data is proprietary.

projects.name: Student Performance Dashboard
projects.description: Comprehensive analytics dashboard tracking student KPIs, attendance patterns, and performance trends to enable data-driven decisions for academic management.
projects.details: Tracking academic outcomes and attendance data in real-time, this dashboard acts as a central hub for educators to identify at-risk students and deploy timely interventions. Designed for scalability across multiple cohorts and subject areas.

projects.name: Automated Student Communication Workflow
projects.description: Automated workflow distributing 500+ personalised emails with pagination logic, concurrency controls, and status-tracking to prevent duplicate communications.
projects.details: Replaced a manual 8-hour process with an automated workflow running in under 5 minutes. Logic includes pagination to address API row limitations, concurrency controls to prevent data file-locking issues, and a status-tracking mechanism to update records upon successful delivery — maintaining a reliable process audit trail.
